situation.zh: 每天傍晚有一群人在河边一起散步。你看了几天了,今天想上去问能不能跟他们一起走,以及他们几点集合。
situation.en: A group walks by the river together every evening. You have watched them for a few days and today you want to ask whether you can walk with them and when they meet.

npc.persona: A member of the walking group, stretching before they set off. Open and encouraging.
npc.greeting: You have been sitting there a few evenings now.

hit: Walk with us? Please do. We meet here at six, every day but Sunday.
Of course you can join. Six o'clock by this bench. We go slowly, do not worry.
partial: You want to walk with us? And what else did you ask?
Join us, yes. Was there a question about the time?

slots.zh_hint: 指明是什么活动:傍晚散步
问一个落地的问题:几点 / 在哪集合

reference_answer: Can I walk with your group? What time do you meet?

provenance.rationale: 加入一个固定的日常小团体 —— 散步、球场、合唱、遛狗 —— 是搬到新地方后建立归属的主要途径。它必须问出集合时间才算真的加入,所以比一次性的搭话更进一步。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 3 层(归属)。walk / join / what time / evening 均为高频词;youth 级要求同时交付加入请求与一个事务性追问,「walk with you? what time?」即算传达到。
